27/* @brief Parameters for a camera sensor (fixed or wrist-mounted).
28 * Loaded from a .superdex_sensor JSON file via SReflect.
29 * Fields with value 0 mean "use engine default". */
30struct CameraSensorParams {
31 DynamicString name;
32
33 int imageWidth = 0;
34 int imageHeight = 0;
35
36 real fovVerticalDeg = 0_r;
37 real nearClip = 0_r;
38 real farClip = 0_r;
39
40 /* Look-at target in world space (fixed cameras only). */
41 Real3 lookAt = {};
42
43 /* Offset from EE frame origin in local coordinates (wrist cameras only). */
44 Real3 offsetLocal = {};
45
46 /* Forward direction in EE-local frame (wrist cameras only). */
47 Real3 forwardAxis = {};
48
49 /* Up direction in EE-local frame (wrist cameras only). */
50 Real3 upAxisLocal = {};
51
52 /* Distance ahead of offset point to place look-at target (wrist cameras only). */
53 real lookDistance = 0_r;
54
55 /* @brief Load sensor parameters from a JSON file.
56 * @param path Path to a .superdex_sensor JSON file.
57 * @param error Error status.
58 * @return Loaded parameters. */
59 static MOCHI_API CameraSensorParams LoadFromFile(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error);
60
61 /* @brief Save sensor parameters to a JSON file.
62 * @param path Destination file path.
63 * @param error Error status. */
64 MOCHI_API void SaveToFile(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const;
65
66 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::CameraSensorParams)
67 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
68 MOCHI_FIELD(imageWidth) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("px"));
69 MOCHI_FIELD(imageHeight) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("px"));
70 MOCHI_FIELD(fovVerticalDeg) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("deg"));
71 MOCHI_FIELD(nearClip) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
72 MOCHI_FIELD(farClip) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
73 MOCHI_FIELD(lookAt) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
74 MOCHI_FIELD(offsetLocal) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
75 MOCHI_FIELD(forwardAxis)
76 MOCHI_FIELD(upAxisLocal)
77 MOCHI_FIELD(lookDistance) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
78 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
79};

81/* @brief Camera sensor runtime object.
82 * Stores intrinsics/extrinsics for use by renderers (UE, etc.).
83 * No ComputeSignal — cameras don't produce data in the mochi physics loop;
84 * renderers query GetParams() to configure their camera actors. */
85// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
86class MOCHI_API CameraSensor : public SensorBase {
87 public:
88 /* @brief Registration type name for this sensor (see RoboticsContext::RegisterSensorType).
89 * @return This sensor's registration type name. */
90 static constexpr std::string_view TypeName() {
91 return "SENSOR_CAMERA";
92 }
93
94 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GetTypeName() const override {
95 return TypeName();
96 }
97
98 /* Nothing to clear between episodes: a camera holds only its params and pose. */
99 void Reset() override {}
100
101 using Params = CameraSensorParams;
102
103 /* @brief Construct from @p paramArgs -- either a params file path or an inline JSON string (empty
104 * uses defaults); the sensor loads its own params. This is the factory
105 * RoboticsContext::RegisterSensor uses. */
106 CameraSensor(Actor* linkActor, std::string_view paramArgs, superdex::Error& error);
107
108 /* @brief Construct from a pre-loaded params struct (programmatic / non-filesystem construction).
109 */
110 CameraSensor(Actor* linkActor, Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
111
112 /* @brief Get sensor parameters.
113 * @return The params. */
114 [[nodiscard]] Params const& GetParams() const {
115 return _params;
116 }
117
118 /* @brief Set sensor parameters.
119 * @param params Params.
120 * @param error Error status. */
121 void SetParams(Params const& params, [[maybe_unused]] superdex::Error& error) {
122 _params = params;
123 }
124
125 private:
126 Params _params;
127};
